title: Expansion of Human Papillomavirus-Specific T Cells in Periphery and Cervix in a Therapeutic Vaccine Recipient Whose Cervical High-Grade Squamous Intraepithelial Lesion Regressed
description: Single-cell TCR/transcriptome analysis for a peripheral blood lymphocytes (PBL) specimen was perform on a 10X Chromium instrument using a single-cell VDJ kit Overall design: Single-cell TCR/transcriptome analysis was performed on a PBL specimen, obtained from a patient who received a thrapeutic HPV vaccine. For details, please read the manuscript, which has been accepted for publication in the journal Frontiers in Immunology.
